heading: What changed when you took your step?
intro: If God used a step you took to change something, big or small, I'd love to hear it. Write it in your own words. No right answer and no need to make it sound impressive. Herman

fields.name: story
fields.label: What changed when you took your step?
fields.help: Your own words. A few sentences is plenty. Please leave out other people's names and private details.

fields.name: name
fields.label: First name or initials
fields.help: Optional. If Herman shares your words, this is the only name he'll use.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.help: Optional. Only so Herman can write back. It is never shown or shared.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: Herman may share my words publicly, with my first name or initials only. He may shorten them for length, but he won't change what I meant.
fields.help: Leave this unchecked if you'd rather keep it between you and Herman. You can still send it.

privacyNote: Nothing is shared publicly unless you check the box. Herman reviews every testimony before any public use. Email addresses are never published. Sending this does not sign you up for any emails. This form isn't watched around the clock. If you're in danger or having thoughts of not wanting to live, please call or text 988 in the U.S., or call 911.
offline: You're offline. We'll hold this and send it as soon as you're connected.

thankYou.heading: Thank you
thankYou.body:
Thank you for trusting me with this. Your story matters, and I'll read it myself.

If the book helped you, an honest Amazon review helps other people find it. That's completely optional, and you're welcome to use your own words from above.
thankYou.takedown: Changed your mind about sharing? Email Herman@freedombychoice.com and we'll take it down.
thankYou.close: Now close the app and take your next step.
